final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref COLLATE BINARY = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.mix, s1.a, s1.c, s1.a - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_second, AVG(c) AS avg_third, AVG(d) AS avg_fourth FROM s3
